heroHeadline: SAF Dual-Front Advance: Retakes Al-Hamadi (South Kordofan) and Omdurman Southern Neighborhoods; Sudan Declared World's Hungriest Country
heroSubtitle: On Day 1124, SAF ground forces retook Al-Hamadi in South Kordofan — a Hawazma administrative hub — and cleared the Al-Jami'a and Al-Shaqla neighborhoods in southern Omdurman, eliminating the last significant RSF pockets in the greater Khartoum metro area. The multi-front advance follows a cluster of SAF gains across five states in three days: Al-Kayli recaptured in Blue Nile (May 10), Al-Khiwai in West Kordofan (May 11), and two consecutive days of SAF drone strikes on Nyala that downed an RSF Bayraktar Akıncı UCAV. Analysts at Asharq Al-Awsat assessed that three senior RSF defections in two months — including Brigadier General El Safana's May 11 departure — may mark the beginning of an RSF 'breakup phase.' Simultaneously, new IPC data released in May 2026 confirmed Sudan has surpassed all other countries to become the world's hungriest nation: famine (IPC Phase 5) is confirmed in El Fasher and Kadugli, with risk extending to two new Darfur areas, and 19.1 million people face IPC Phase 3+ acute food insecurity during the lean season. On May 12, SAF drones struck four simultaneous targets in Al-Daein, East Darfur, including RSF commanders' residences and the Andour Well civilian water source. Sudan's civil war enters Day 1124 with 14 million displaced, 880+ civilians killed by drones in the first four months of 2026, 34 million in urgent need of humanitarian aid, and the UN appeal only 16% funded.
